To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

continuous theta burst transcranial magnetic brain stimulation applied over the posterior parietal lobe of the contralesioned hemisphere can ameliorate spatial symptoms of neglect on a standardized observation questionnaire of everyday behaviour, which also leads to improved performance in neuropsychological tests.

continuous theta burst trains of stimulation applied over the left posterior parieto-temporal cortex significantly improve spatial neglect on a standardized, quantitative measure of the daily living activities in subacute patients.

the repeated application of inhibitory transcranial theta burst stimulation trains over the contralesional posterior parietal lobe in patients suffering from left spatial neglect significantly improves the activities of daily life during spontaneous behaviour, as measured with the Catherine Bergegò scale.

the application of continuous theta-burst stimulation over two consecutive days can ameliorate the severity of spatial neglect symptoms during spontaneous activities of daily living and that this amelioration persists for at least 21 days after stimulation.
